description: Same policy as gated: every update gets GitHub's auto-merge and is merged once a code owner approves it and CI passes, except a new trivy minor or major, which is merged by hand

packageRules.description: Kubernetes libraries and controller-runtime move as one release train

The trivy binary in the image has to stay on the minor of the Trivy server it talks to (ADR 0003), which trivy-operator in fleet-infra decides. A new minor only opens a pull request, to be merged together with the server's upgrade

mirror.gcr.io gives no release time, so the two-day wait would hold every trivy update back for good. The wait is skipped for this image alone. A patch still has to be approved and pass CI before it is merged, and a new minor still only opens a pull request, to be merged by hand together with the Trivy server's upgrade (ADR 0003), so a person sees it before it is merged
The image in config/ names the branch, not a version; fleet-infra pins the version
